answer: Each identity keeps a lantern in the ocean and locks 60 credits. Joining needs a key-signed lotus seal for one real job. Each epoch the beacon openly draws one lantern in ten; each must answer a 5-credit heartbeat in 60 seconds. A missed heartbeat or failed lotus replay burns 8; three burn the bond. 1,000 fakes pay 45,000, lock 60,000, burn 500 an epoch against a 40,000 pool. A rented heartbeat surrenders key and bond; honest agents pay 45 once.
